sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Türkiye
sources.officialityEvidence: Türkiye's current nationality schedule splits Iraqi ordinary passports by age: under 15 and over 50 are exempt, while ages 15–50 require visas and only conditionally qualify for eVisa with specified third-country documents.

policies.title: Iraqi ordinary passports: Grenada advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy-linked nationality schedule places Iraq in its Prior to Arrival visa cohort.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Iraqi passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The schedule defines Prior to Arrival as obtaining the visa at a Grenadian mission or consulate before travel.
Work, study, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Iraqi ordinary passports: Panama authorized visitor visa
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule places Iraq in its authorized-visa cohort for advance immigration approval.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Iraqi passport holder who does not qualify for Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver.
Authorized-visa approval may take up to 60 business days and must be granted before travel.
Washington-specific filing mechanics are not generalized to every consular district; final admission remains discretionary.

conflicts.explanation: Türkiye exempts Iraqi ordinary-passport holders under 15 and over 50, requires ages 15–50 to hold a visa, and limits their eVisa to qualifying third-country documents; no single passport-only status represents the current rule.
